channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dennis Rodman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dennis Rodman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tim Hardaway on Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Luc Longley
item.description:
“I’m talking about one-on-one, if it was one-on-one, he would get cooked. Cuz ain’t nobody there. Scottie Pippen ain’t coming there to block your shot. Luc Longley… he not coming over there and put his big body on you, and he would hurt you, too…Dennis Rodman, he ain’t coming there to take the charge,”

Tim Hardaway on Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Luc Longley, Mar 5, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Furkan Korkmaz on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Furkan Korkmaz:

“Very tough question… Dennis Rodman! That would be a real battle between the two.”

Furkan Korkmaz on Dennis Rodman, Aug 31, 2025. Source: Meridian Sports.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell, Moses Malone, Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Andre Drummond:

“My Mount Rushmore of rebounders? Dennis Rodman, Moses Malone, Bill Russell, and Tristan Thompson. Dennis is a no-brainer—his numbers are insane. He once had 26 rebounds and no points in a game. Moses had an incredible knack for tipping the ball in and controlling the boards. Bill Russell’s rebounding numbers were out of this world, even though I’ve only seen clips of him. And Tristan? That’s personal. Battling with him in the paint was always a fight. He’s got a natural feel for rebounding. Those guys inspired me to be the best rebounder I could be.”

Andre Drummond on Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell, Moses Malone, Tristan Thompson, Jan 22, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal on Dennis Rodman:

“This dude would come to the meetings at 5:30. You had to be there at 5:30, 45 minutes to go. He’d come in with 40 minutes on the clock, eating chicken and rice, not paying attention, doing whatever. In the middle of the meeting, he’d take a cold shower, not paying attention. We’d go out first, then he’d come out, give you 25 rebounds, stinking like a motherfucker, put his clothes on, and go to the club. And he had the baddest women I’ve ever seen in my life surrounding him, hugging him.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Dennis Rodman, Aug 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Draymond Green told Scoop B Radio.

“How he approached things and the force he always brought to the game no matter what. Most people would say he was off his rocker. It didn’t affect him one bit. If you said Dennis Rodman was off his rocker, you’d go further off the rocker. I respect guys like that. The thing you have to remember is that I was born in 1990 and so as much as I had the opportunity to watch those guys, I was six when the Bulls won a championship in 1996. I was eight when they won their last championship. A lot of that is going back and just watching.”

Draymond Green on Dennis Rodman, Jul 2, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Shawn Kemp on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Reflecting on the series, Kemp, a three-time All-NBA forward, acknowledged Michael Jordan’s brilliance but emphasized that it was Rodman’s defensive prowess and relentless rebounding that disrupted the Sonics’ rhythm.

“Everyone talks about MJ, and of course, he was phenomenal. But it was Rodman’s defensive play and his ability to control the boards that really threw us off,”

Shawn Kemp on Dennis Rodman, Jun 22, 2024. Source: hip-hopvibe.com.

item.title: Shawn Kemp on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Kemp praised Rodman’s impact, highlighting how his tenacity on defense and knack for getting under opponents’ skin made him a game-changer.

“Rodman was everywhere on the court, and his energy was infectious. He did the dirty work that doesn’t always show up on the stat sheet but makes a huge difference in the game,”

Shawn Kemp on Dennis Rodman, Jun 22, 2024. Source: hip-hopvibe.com.

item.title: Jerry Buss on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
He was referring to when Rodman said during an interview with VLAD TV in September that he and Buss dated for six months, which at the time didn’t sit well with his Lakers teammates, Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O’Neal.

“I mean yes, in other words, when my dad [former Lakers owner Jerry Buss] brought on Dennis Rodman to the team it was kind of like, ‘Let’s make sure that we know where he is at all times,'”

Jerry Buss on Dennis Rodman, Nov 10, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Steven Adams on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Steven Adams on rebounding:

“You could go into the Dennis Rodman stuff. He had it down to a science, talking about the rotations of the ball and stuff. He’s wild, mate.“I’m too stupid for that, mate. I don’t have enough brain cells for that one, brother. I just stand there.”

Steven Adams on Dennis Rodman, Mar 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Steve Kerr, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I think they [covered] Dennis Rodman more than Scottie — and Steve Kerr in ‘The Last Dance,'”

Charles Oakley on Steve Kerr, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Jan 28, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jud Buechler on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
A lot of his behavior was at the forefront of the mental health issues that athletes have begun to open up about.

“Regardless of what Dennis did off the court, he always delivered during the games,”

Jud Buechler on Dennis Rodman, Nov 18, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Luc Longley on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
A less likely friendship, however, was the one that he formed with the mercurial Rodman.

“Dennis was so far outside of our monoculture of basketball that I was intrigued by that,”

Luc Longley on Dennis Rodman, Aug 3, 2021. Source: ABC.net.au.

item.title: Luc Longley on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I felt like I sat outside the sort of the stereotypical basketball frame and Dennis did too. So I was attracted to him. And I think he’s probably attracted to me.”

Luc Longley on Dennis Rodman, Aug 3, 2021. Source: ABC.net.au.

item.title: Luc Longley on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I tended to roll with Dennis a bit after the game and ended up in some places that I wouldn’t have otherwise ended up in, which I’ve put in the life experience bag,”

Luc Longley on Dennis Rodman, Aug 3, 2021. Source: ABC.net.au.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Metta World Peace on looking up to Dennis Rodman, whom he recognized as struggling with mental health before many others did:

“Dennis Rodman was the first one to come out [and publicly say he was managing his mental health] -- he was on Oprah [in 1996] -- he talked about his family. When I saw that, I'm like,”

Metta World Peace on Dennis Rodman, May 20, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dennis Rodman, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Andre Drummond:

“He's the Dennis Rodman of our day as far as rebounding. He has a knack for rebounding...his future is going to be bright in this league.”

Dwane Casey on Dennis Rodman, Andre Drummond, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Montrezl Harrell on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Montrezl Harrell:

“I’ve been telling people, I’m the modern day Rodman, for real. I’m the modern day Rodman. That’s it. Rodman, man. Just to watch his whole process in general, man. Like, even after the documentary, I got on the Twitter and tweeted “Hey man, we gotta give a lot more credit then what we did”

Montrezl Harrell on Dennis Rodman, Jul 22, 2020. Source: Clipperholics.

item.title: Carmen Electra on Michael Jordan, Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“Dennis gets up to answer, and there’s Michael Jordan! I got up and tried to hide. I knew Dennis was in trouble. That was a big deal and a shock to me.”

Carmen Electra on Michael Jordan, Dennis Rodman, Apr 27, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
said Golden State Warriors coach and former Bulls guard Steve Kerr recently on a conference call.

“It wasn’t a thing where we were all complaining of Dennis not making it to a practice. We sort of understood that he was his own man and he did so much for our team that we allowed him to have that freedom.”

Steve Kerr on Dennis Rodman, Apr 26, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Thomas elaborated Monday during a promotional appearance in Southfield, Michigan, for his Champagne Cheurlin, the first African American-owned champagne company.

“All of us who knew Dennis, he was a guy who never drank, never did drugs. He was a gentle, innocent soul,”

Isiah Thomas on Dennis Rodman, Sep 17, 2019. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Penny Marshall on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
says Matthew Conlan, Marshall's son-in-law, a producer on the film.

Penny Marshall on Dennis Rodman, Jan 3, 2019. Source: The Hollywood Reporter.

item.title: Nick Young on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“Dennis Rodman came in my dream last night, and I was wondering why he came in my dream. He had the purple hair, all kinds of stuff,”

Nick Young on Dennis Rodman, May 27, 2018. Source: USA Today.

item.description:
Young told reporters postgame.

“He told me, 'Tomorrow you're going to play a little defense,' and I was like, 'Nah that's not my game, Dennis Rodman, why you in my dream?'”

Nick Young on Dennis Rodman, May 27, 2018. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Kendrick Perkins, Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I became a better screener by watching guys like Kendrick Perkins, Dennis Rodman,”

Marcin Gortat on Kendrick Perkins, Dennis Rodman, May 5, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: LeBron James on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“Iheard Dennis Rodman say if I played in their era I’d just be an average player – yeah, about me, that I’d be just an average player,”

LeBron James on Dennis Rodman, Mar 10, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Adam Zagoria:Charles Barkley:

“Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, you think they would be overwhelmed by that little Warriors team? Come on, man. The notion that Michael, Scottie and Dennis and those guys couldn't play up-tempo with those guys [Warriors] is just silly. And Michael Jordan with no hand-checking? Are you f***ing kidding me? The guy averaged over 30 points with hand-checking. Nobody gonna watch the Washington Wizards play the Orlando Magic non-stop unless they're f***ing idiots.”

Charles Barkley on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Mar 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
Thompson told Basketball Insiders.

“I watch a lot of Dennis Rodman film, see how he impacted the game, see how he impacted his team when he was playing. Especially for this team, I feel like I can do that and bring it to the table. That’s what I try to do every night.”

Tristan Thompson on Dennis Rodman, May 6, 2015. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Shaquille O'Neal, Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell
item.description:
“I’ve seen Shaq [Shaquille O’Neal] win titles, Bill Russell win titles, Dennis Rodman win titles. So there’s a lot of guys that have missed free throws and won a lot of NBA titles, so that’s not a concern for me at all. What D.J. does for our team is far more valuable than those missed free throws. “I can’t remember the last time he didn’t [have energy for us]. He plays with great spirit and plays hard pretty much every night and he does everything right for us. I agree with Jeff Van Gundy, he should just go walk out on the All-Star Game and go play. Just start playing. Nobody’s going to tell him to get off [the court]. So I think he should just go do it.”

Doc Rivers on Shaquille O'Neal, Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell, Feb 8, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Kenny Anderson on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“Me and Dennis do some things. We (both) live in Fort Lauderdale, and I do a lot of clinics and camps,”

Kenny Anderson on Dennis Rodman, Feb 12, 2014. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I mean, we really want to find peace with this country and if Dennis could have helped that I would have been really happy for that.”

Phil Jackson on Dennis Rodman, Jan 31, 2014. Source: Sulia.
